script: This chapter gives you a twelve-week learning route. It works for any skill. Replace the examples with the lessons of your own chosen skill. In weeks one and two, build your foundations. Learn how files and folders work: saving, naming, sharing and sending attachments. Learn basic typing and keyboard shortcuts, such as copy, paste and undo. Learn to write a clear message, with a short greeting, one clear purpose and a polite sign-off. Then do the free basics of your chosen skill. In weeks two and three, learn your chosen skill. Follow one main course, not five. Watch one lesson, then practise straight away. For every hour of video, plan at least one hour of practice. Keep a short log of what you did each day. This log becomes part of your story when you talk to clients.
